crop.notes: Whole 'Sporting Notes' column: baseball report, Allen and Kelly, Bauer and Christol, and the Temple match preview.

ocr.notes: Gist readable; many character errors in the lower half (faint print).

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, the champion, boxed a glove contest with retired pugilist Tom Kelly at Kelly's benefit at the Theatre Comique, the best display of skill seen in some time.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Dispatch, Saturday Evening, May 6, 1876 (pre-1878 Dispatch). Exhibition was 'last evening' (May 5). Same page as 554.

facts.fact: Allen, called 'the champion', boxed a glove contest with retired pugilist Tom Kelly at Kelly's benefit at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis
